headline: How Burry’s Bet and OA Pipeline Push Will Impact Zoetis (ZTS) Investors
summary: Recently, investor Michael Burry increased his position in Zoetis, as the company works through competitive pressures and safety concerns around some companion animal osteoarthritis products while advancing 12 pipeline candidates targeting unmet medical needs. Zoetis has also rolled out new osteoarthritis therapies in Canada and the EU, drawing attention to how its innovation pipeline may balance current challenges in its core companion animal portfolio.
